models_evaluated: multi-label neural network imitation learning DDSS

links.outcome: Clinician disagreement with model recommendations versus observed practice in randomized blinded equivalence study
links.effect: Diagnostic disagreements were statistically equivalent between model recommendations and observed practice, while order disagreements were not equivalent.
links.quote: In clinician-validation, diagnostic disagreements were statistically equivalent between model recommendations and observed practice while order disagreements were not.

unlisted_practices: Imitation learning from collective clinician decisions instead of expert-adjudicated gold-standard labels

screen.reason: The study develops and retrospectively/blinded-evaluates an imitation learning-based diagnostic decision support system using EHR data, without testing an organizational deployment safeguard or guardrail practice.
